question: Should `text/vcard` become a default host-read document MIME when the entire buffer must pass the existing text validator?
rationale: The code is correct and proven, but allowing another host-local file type is an intentional security-policy expansion that automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept Validated vCards
options.body: Allow `text/vcard` by default with the full-buffer guard and use this PR as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Keep The Existing Boundary
options.body: Retain the current allowlist and require the existing base64 buffer workaround for vCards.

recommendation.title: Accept Validated vCards
recommendation.body: Allow `text/vcard` by default with the full-buffer guard and use this PR as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the host-read media capability boundary whose default policy this PR changes.
